description: Three contrasting fictional save choices to accompany DEEP END. Story notes guide future labels or narration; only the separate structured scene and motion files populate the existing B-roll templates.

games.title: SUNROOM LINE
games.premise: A tram stop above the clouds where the last afternoon of summer never quite ends.
games.story_direction: The tram takes you to a place where you felt safe. You can rest as long as you need, and leave when you are ready. This choice has no hidden punishment.
games.visual_clue: The open amber-lit tram door, well-kept platform, flowers, and small HOME destination board.

games.title: VELVET ORCHARD
games.premise: An impossibly beautiful peach orchard growing inside a deserted pastel shopping mall.
games.story_direction: Each peach lets you relive a perfect memory, but the orchard keeps that memory afterward. Visitors eventually forget why they wanted to leave. The fruit's warmth is a lure.
games.visual_clue: Pale roots quietly hold abandoned suitcases beneath the glowing fruit.

games.title: SIGNAL 03
games.choice: Cannot tell whether it is good or bad
games.premise: An error cartridge opens a lift in an unfinished lavender field, with a sunlit school corridor on the other side.
games.story_direction: It may be restoring a lost save or inventing a world from someone else's memories. Keep the outcome unresolved; the doorway offers no reliable instructions.
games.visual_clue: The corridor cannot fit behind the freestanding frame; a few rectangular ground patches have no texture.
